question: What is born from awareness of flashing aspects of being?
premises: in those whose forms are consciousness vibration will knowledge action
by force of their own appropriateness
from the grace of the five brahman limbs
born from awareness of flashing aspects of being
inference: the form born from awareness of flashing aspects of being arises through appropriateness and the grace of five brahman limbs
plain_english: In those whose forms are consciousness-vibration, will, knowledge, and action, by force of their own appropriateness and from the grace of the five brahman limbs, arises what is born from awareness of flashing aspects of being.
